messages:
Ruth (Product): quick sync — Helix rollout dependencies. target: private beta with SLA window by month-end.
Diego - Eng: main ask: runtime contract for tenant-prefetch + eviction. who owns correctness on eviction semantics?
Mira (Runtime): runtime owns semantics. propose a small contract header: `x-prefetch=true|false` and `evict_after_secs`. will post draft.
Evan (Infra): infra needs expected warmup_tokens and per-tenant qps to size warm pools. rough numbers?
Ruth (Product): two anchor customers: Nimbus (200 rps spikes), Helio (50-150 rps). sustained 30-70.
Sam (Security): for private beta we need KMS integration and audit-log retention policy. also confirm whether tenant data stays in EU for Helio.
Diego - Eng: noted. also request ability to force-fallback to fp16 via admin API during beta. reduces blast radius.
Mira (Runtime): will add `admin.force_variant(tenant, variant)` to the runtime admin API. small PR incoming.
Evan (Infra): I'll model two capacity plans (reserved warm-pool vs ephemeral spin-up) and include cost deltas; ETA Tue.
Ruth (Product): acceptance criteria draft: p95 < 300ms, successful HSM signoff, and signed model artifacts for private tenants.
Sam (Security): signoff timeline ~10 business days for HSM + policy. will prioritize Helio onboarding.
ops-bot: staging deploy helix-v0.8 started (sha: be34f0) — ETA 8m.
Diego - Eng: I'll post a short bench CSV and tail latency numbers to this thread after the PR lands.
Ruth (Product): action items recap: 1) Mira: post runtime header contract by EOD Thu. 2) Evan: capacity plans Tue. 3) Sam: KMS signoff ETA next Tue. 4) Diego: bench CSV when ready. reconvene Wed 9am. :thumbsup:
